renforge_advance.description: Advance one dialogue event from the currently active queue. Prefer `renforge_control(action="advance")` only when you intentionally need control-command consistency with other navigation actions.

project_path.description: Project root of the running live session.

renforge_assets.description: Run static asset validation and return missing/orphaned image or audio references. Useful before build and before submitting translation/build changes.

project_path.description: Project root to inspect.

renforge_autopilot.description: Auto-play branches by stopping any current manual session and launching a fresh session for every replay. It writes incremental progress to `.renforge/autopilot.json` and may download/cache the required SDK. Best for broad checks; not deterministic and potentially expensive.

project_path.description: Project root for the live session.

renforge_capture_screenshot.description: Persist the current frame under `.renforge/captures/` and return the output path plus hash. This writes disk and may overwrite an existing name.

crop_height.description: Crop height; 0 disables cropping in Y.

crop_width.description: Crop width; 0 disables cropping in X.

crop_x.description: Crop origin x in logical coordinates.

crop_y.description: Crop origin y in logical coordinates.

crosshair_x.description: Crosshair x coordinate; both x/y must be set together.

crosshair_y.description: Crosshair y coordinate; both x/y must be set together.

grid.description: Guide overlay grid spacing in pixels.

name.description: Capture base filename (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

rulers.description: Draw rulers along frame edges for measurement.

renforge_click_at.description: Click a coordinate in screenshot or logical space. Use semantic click first (`renforge_click_element`) and fall back when text/id selectors are unavailable. Combine with coordinate space and frame/state guards.

expected_frame_id.description: Frame id that must match for safety checks.

expected_state.description: Optional expected runtime state dictionary before click.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in selected coordinate space.

y.description: Vertical coordinate in selected coordinate space.

renforge_click_element.description: Click a semantic UI element by text/id/screen (preferred). Falls back safely through fresh frame guards and returns focus hints when another element captures the hit test. Use `renforge_click_at` only as coordinate fallback.

effect_timeout.description: How long to wait when `wait_for_effect` is true.

element_id.description: Exact control id override when text is unstable.

expected_frame_id.description: Optional frame id from a recent scene/listing call; when supplied it rejects a stale frame.

interaction_id.description: Optional interaction correlation id for logs/troubleshooting.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

screen.description: Optional screen name filter to scope semantic lookup.

text.description: Preferred visible text matcher for the target control.

wait_for_effect.description: Wait for a visual effect/state update before returning.

renforge_context.description: Return the same full payload as `renforge_info`, including active project discovery, dashboard/runtime hints, and RenForge version. This is an alias, not a reduced view.

renforge_control.description: Run a runtime control action (`advance`, `rollback`, `toggle_skip`, `toggle_auto`, `toggle_afm`, `game_menu`, `hide_windows`, `quick_save`, `quick_load`, `reload_script`, `restart_interaction`, `quit`). Use `quick_load` with care: it replaces live state. `quit` stops the active game session. `renforge_advance` is a narrower alternative for pure advance actions. Destructive actions require `authorize=true` when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`.

authorize.description: Explicitly authorize destructive actions when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`; ignored for lower-risk actions.

effect_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait when `wait_for_effect` is enabled.

interaction_id.description: Optional interaction correlation id used for safety checks and logs.

project_path.description: Project root with running live session.

wait_for_effect.description: Wait until bridge reports visible state effect before returning.

renforge_diff_screenshots.description: Diff two PNG frames and return whether pixels changed plus the minimal changed rectangle. Use for regression checks between pre/post actions.

after_path.description: Path to comparison PNG; omit to compare against current live frame.

project_path.description: Project root used for path resolution of before/after images.

threshold.description: Pixel-difference threshold; higher values reduce sensitivity.

renforge_distribute.description: Build desktop distribution packages and write them to destination. This executes packaging toolchains and may download and cache the SDK; it can be slow or destructive when output paths are reused.

project_path.description: Project root to package.

renforge_estimate_translation.description: Estimate geometric translation between two images for visual text alignment workflows. This is file-only and read-only.

max_shift.description: Maximum per-axis shift considered during matching.

renforge_eval.description: Evaluate an arbitrary Python expression in the running store namespace. This may call project functions and mutate runtime state or access the filesystem, start processes, and use the network with the game process's permissions. Prefer `renforge_get_var` for plain reads and use this only for controlled diagnostics. Pass `authorize=true` when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`, unless this operation is allowlisted.

authorize.description: Explicitly authorize this open-world expression when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`.

expr.description: Python expression to evaluate in the store namespace.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

renforge_export_dialogue.description: Export dialogue for translators or external tooling. This may download and cache the SDK, then writes and overwrites `dialogue.txt` at the project root.

project_path.description: Project root whose dialogue should be exported.

renforge_find_image_on_screen.description: Find a template image on the current frame and return matches with bounds in screenshot coordinates. Use this to close the control loop after screenshot capture and click fallback.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

region_height.description: Optional region height; set width/height together.

region_width.description: Optional region width; set width/height together.

region_x.description: Optional region x origin to limit search area.

region_y.description: Optional region y origin to limit search area.

template_path.description: Template image path relative to project or absolute.

renforge_find_references.description: Find symbol definitions and references across scripts and templates with the same pagination controls as scan. Useful before editing or renaming project identifiers.

file_glob.description: Optional glob filter limiting candidate files.

limit.description: Maximum results to return; keep this bounded for large codebases.

project_path.description: Project root where symbol references should be resolved.

symbol.description: Symbol name to resolve (for example label, define, or python identifier).

renforge_game_state.description: Read full live state for debugging and monitoring. Use this before/after interactions to verify state deltas without changing variables directly. Request optional sections such as `metrics` and `audio`.

include.description: Optional sections to include in addition to default state (for example metrics, audio).

project_path.description: Project root with an active live session.

renforge_game_state_compact.description: Read bounded live state with explicit variable limits and payload caps for large sessions. Use this in loops and scripts to keep responses predictable.

max_depth.description: Maximum object nesting depth to serialize, from 0 through 20.

max_items.description: Maximum variable count before trimming, from 1 through 10000.

max_output_bytes.description: Payload cap in bytes, from 64 through 2000000.

project_path.description: Project root with an active live session.

variable_names.description: Restrict output to these variable names.

variable_prefix.description: Filter variable names by this prefix.

renforge_generate_translations.description: Generate or update translation files under `game/tl/<language>/`. This may download and cache the SDK before writing output. It writes files, so treat it as destructive when run against production trees and prefer checking stats first.

project_path.description: Project root to write translation files for.

renforge_get_displayable_bounds.description: Read placement bounds for a rendered displayable tag by tag name. Use this to diagnose layout changes or anchor calculations before moving elements.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

renforge_get_doc.description: Read a single Ren'Py documentation topic. For discovery, run `renforge_search_docs` and `renforge_list_docs` first to avoid guessing IDs. This may download and cache the SDK before resolving doc content.

topic.description: Topic identifier or slug in the doc catalog.

renforge_get_errors.description: Read recent runtime and bridge errors. Run this after risky actions or after a stop to confirm the game did not crash with hidden diagnostics.

project_path.description: Project root; this can still read bounded crash files after the runtime stops.

since.description: Exclusive cursor for paginating older logs/diagnostics.

renforge_get_ui_element_bounds.description: Resolve semantic element bounds without clicking. Use this after list output to verify target geometry before any pointer action.

element_id.description: Element id matcher for a precise target.

expected_frame_id.description: Optional frame guard token for freshness.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

screen.description: Optional screen filter for targeted lookup.

renforge_get_var.description: Read one named variable from the live store. JSON-safe values are returned as-is; other objects are replaced by a type label without calling conversion hooks such as `__repr__`. Resolving the name can still run a store property getter. Prefer this over `renforge_eval` when you only need a named lookup.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

renforge_hit_test.description: Inspect which interactive nodes sit under a coordinate. Use this when click targets look stale or overlays may absorb events, and prefer semantic selectors once ambiguity is resolved.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate system for the test point (`logical` or `screenshot`).

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

renforge_hover_element.description: Move cursor over a semantic control by text/id/screen. Prefer this before click when checking hover states or tooltips.

element_id.description: Element id matcher for precise targeting.

expected_frame_id.description: Frame id expected from recent scene/listing calls.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

screen.description: Screen filter for ambiguous UI states.

text.description: Text matcher for the control to hover.

renforge_info.description: Call this first. It returns the active project target (dashboard, "serve_default" or cwd), plus local runtime hints and RenForge version. Use this to determine the project path you should pass to project-scoped tools.

renforge_inspect_image.description: Inspect a local image file and optionally crop/zoom it before returning PNG bytes. Use this for artifact review without launching the game.

crop_height.description: Optional crop height in pixels; 0 keeps full height.

crop_width.description: Optional crop width in pixels; 0 keeps full width.

crop_x.description: Pixel offset from left for the crop rectangle origin.

crop_y.description: Pixel offset from top for the crop rectangle origin.

image_path.description: Local image path to load and inspect.

scale.description: Scale multiplier applied after crop; > 1 zooms in, < 1 zooms out.

renforge_inspect_project.description: Read-only static analysis of a Ren'Py project: scan metadata and file structure without starting the game engine. Use this for safe project triage before runtime actions.

project_path.description: Absolute or relative Ren'Py project root containing `game/`.

renforge_inspect_screen.description: Inspect a named active screen, including layer, scope and arguments. Useful for branch verification before choosing click or hover selectors.

name.description: Screen name to inspect in the live bridge state.

project_path.description: Project root with active game session.

renforge_jump.description: Restart into a specific label/file position and keep interacting in a fresh game session. If needed, this may download and cache the required SDK before restart. Use for deterministic positioning before scripted checks.

project_path.description: Project root containing the target game.

target.description: Label name or `file:line` destination for relaunch.

version.description: Runtime version to use when restarting at target.

renforge_languages.description: List translation languages currently present under `game/tl/`. Use this before generating or exporting localized files.

project_path.description: Project root for translation inventory.

renforge_launch.description: Start or attach a running game session with Live Editor enabled by default (pass editor=false for non-editor runtime launch). Launch starts the background startup flow, usually returning while startup is still in progress; poll `renforge_launch_status` and capture with `renforge_screenshot` before interaction. It may download/cache the selected SDK, inject session-owned `.rpy` files and editor assets under `game/`, and publish authenticated ownership/bridge metadata under `.renforge/control/`. `renforge_stop` removes only owned session artifacts.

audio.description: Audio strategy: `auto`, `native`, `dummy`, or `none`; both `dummy` and `none` use SDL dummy audio.

cleanup_on_stop.description: When true, stop removes only the temporary save directory created by `savedir=temporary`; arbitrary save directories and existing saves are not deleted.

display.description: Display strategy: `auto`, `native`, `xvfb`, or `external`. The accepted token `none` returns an error because Ren'Py requires a display surface.

editor.description: Enable/disable live editor injection; default True for interactive work.

persistent.description: Persistent mode: `existing` preserves current persistent data and `empty` removes it in the isolated session; `copy` and `fixture` currently set an environment marker only and do not copy or load fixture data.

project_path.description: Project root passed to the launcher and runtime bridge.

savedir.description: Optional save directory override. `temporary` creates an isolated temporary directory; any other non-default value is an arbitrary save directory path that is created if missing and is never removed by stop.

timeout.description: Ren'Py background startup deadline in seconds (0 uses the launcher default). This does not control the MCP response wait; poll `renforge_launch_status` after a `starting` result.

version.description: Launcher version selector, either `stable` or an explicit semantic version (for example `8.5.3`).

warp.description: Optional Ren'Py `file.rpy:line` startup target; this launch tool does not resolve label names.

renforge_launch_status.description: Poll launch progress and return `idle`, `starting`, `ready`, `failed`, `closing`, or `closed`. Use after any launch start when the first call has not returned an immediate ready state.

project_path.description: Project root currently being launched or running.

renforge_list_choices.description: List on-screen menu choices with index and text ordering. Call before `renforge_select_choice` to pick valid entries for the current menu state.

project_path.description: Project root of the running live session.

renforge_list_docs.description: List available Ren'Py documentation topics. Use this as the discovery step before any topic-specific docs read. This may download and cache the SDK if docs are not already available.

renforge_list_ui_elements.description: List focusable UI elements with bounds and element metadata. Use this first for semantic interaction planning; it is narrower than a full scene readout and aligned to click/hover workflows.

element_type.description: Optional element type/class filter (for example button, label).

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

text.description: Optional text filter to narrow focusable candidates.

renforge_measure.description: Measure geometry between scene nodes without visual inspection. `contrast` samples the live frame and reports a WCAG ratio. Use this to detect layout drift after positional edits.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

targets.description: Scene node `id` strings or literal bounds objects `{"x": number, "y": number, "width": number, "height": number}`.

tolerance.description: Optional tolerance; adds a pass verdict (for contrast, the minimum WCAG ratio).

within.description: Optional scene node id or literal `{x,y,width,height}` bounds used as the containing region.
within.title: Within

renforge_new_game.description: Restart at `start` and begin a new story progression. This may download and cache the required SDK before the fresh launch. Prefer this for clean scenario entry rather than reusing unstable runtime state.

project_path.description: Project root containing the game to restart.

version.description: Runtime version used for the fresh launch.

renforge_parse_lint.description: Parse existing Ren'Py lint output text and return normalized diagnostics. This does not run Ren'Py, does not execute code, and does not touch the runtime.

text.description: Existing Ren'Py lint output text to parse.

renforge_poll_events.description: Read queued runtime events since a stream index. Use this for deterministic event-driven debugging instead of polling live UI repeatedly.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

since.description: Exclusive cursor position for pagination of event history.

renforge_position_element.description: Reposition a shown image tag live and return new logical bounds. This mutates runtime placement only; after converging with scene/measure tools, write the final values into the `.rpy` source.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

xpos.description: X position: an integer is absolute logical pixels; a float is a screen fraction (for example 0.5).

ypos.description: Y position: an integer is absolute logical pixels; a float is a screen fraction (for example 0.5).

renforge_run_scenario.description: Run a scripted scenario pipeline of multiple interaction steps in one call and return grouped diagnostics. `eval`, `assert`, and expression-based `wait` steps execute arbitrary Python that may mutate state, access the filesystem, start processes, or use the network. Validate expectations and review capture output on failure. Destructive or open-world steps require `authorize=true` when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`.

authorize.description: Explicitly authorize a destructive or open-world step when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`.

capture_on_failure.description: Capture diagnostics (including image) when step evaluation fails.

name.description: Scenario name used for logs and output grouping.

project_path.description: Project root of the live session.

state_profile.description: Compact state profile used for captures: `minimal`, `interaction`, `debug`, or `full`.

steps.description: Ordered action objects. Supported actions: `set`, `eval`, `click`, `click_at`, `advance`, `scroll`, `wait`, `assert`, `select_choice`, `capture`, `save`, `load`, `control`, and `send_input`.

stop_on_failure.description: Abort remaining steps when one step fails.

timeout.description: Total finite wall-time budget from 0 through 600 seconds.

renforge_saves.description: List, load, or save named slots in a single command family. `list` is read-only; `load` replaces live state and `save` can overwrite the chosen slot. Verify slot names before mutating gameplay progress. `load` requires `authorize=true` when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`.

authorize.description: Explicitly authorize `load` when `RENFORGE_POLICY=enforce`; ignored for list/save.

extra_info.description: Optional save metadata for save actions.

project_path.description: Project root of the running live game.

regexp.description: Optional regex filter for list only, selecting matching slots.

slot.description: Slot label used by save/load actions.

renforge_scan_project.description: Search project scripts with bounded output. Use `sections`, `file_glob`, and `symbol` for focused indexing, then paginate with `offset` and `limit` for stable batches.

file_glob.description: Optional filename glob filter for targeted scan files.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Keep values bounded to avoid large payloads.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset for scan results.

project_path.description: Project root to index for static analysis.

symbol.description: Filter matches for this symbol; empty keeps section-wide scan.

renforge_scene_tree.description: Read the full scene graph (logical scene data). Unlike `renforge_list_ui_elements` this is broad and includes non-focusable nodes, so use it for full-tree inspection when semantic selectors are ambiguous. `save_as` or `diff_against` may create `.renforge/scenes/`; `save_as` writes and overwrites the named JSON snapshot. Omit both options for read-only inspection.

detail.description: Detail granularity (`semantic`, `layout`, or `raw`) for scene nodes.

diff_against.description: Optional snapshot name for diff context; compare against existing `.renforge/scenes/<name>.json` entry.

max_output_depth.description: Maximum traversal depth before truncation, from 0 through 20.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

save_as.description: Optional snapshot name saved under `.renforge/scenes/<name>.json`; reusing a name overwrites it.

renforge_screenshot.description: Capture the current live frame and return an in-memory image response (no persistent file write). Use this to inspect UI state before clicks or scenario actions.

crop_height.description: Crop height; 0 disables cropping in Y.

crop_width.description: Crop width; 0 disables cropping in X.

crop_x.description: Crop origin x in logical coordinates.

crop_y.description: Crop origin y in logical coordinates.

crosshair_x.description: Crosshair x coordinate; both x/y must be set together.

crosshair_y.description: Crosshair y coordinate; both x/y must be set together.

grid.description: Guide overlay grid spacing in pixels.

height.description: Target capture height. Set one axis and keep aspect ratio via runtime logic.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

rulers.description: Draw rulers along frame edges for measurement.

width.description: Target capture width. Set one axis and keep aspect ratio via runtime logic.

renforge_search_docs.description: Search local Ren'Py documentation snippets by keyword before opening results. Use this to identify canonical topic IDs before `renforge_get_doc`. This may download and cache the SDK when docs are not already available.

query.description: Search query for Ren'Py documentation corpus.

renforge_select_choice.description: Select a menu choice by case-insensitive text or zero-based index. Text matching prefers an exact match, then uses the shortest case-insensitive substring match. Use list output first to avoid ambiguous partial text.

index.description: Zero-based choice index fallback when text is omitted.

project_path.description: Project root of the running live session.

text.description: Visible text to match; preferred over index.

renforge_send_input.description: Send exactly one input command path (text, key, or scroll object) into the live game. Keep calls scoped and single-purpose; for deterministic workflows prefer one action per invocation.

key.description: Readable named key such as `enter`, `esc`, an arrow, `pageup`, `pagedown`, `backspace`, `delete`, `home`, `end`, `space`, `tab`, or a function key.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

submit.description: Press Enter after injected text; only valid with text input, not key or scroll.

text.description: Text to inject as character-by-character text input.

renforge_set_var.description: Write a game variable directly in the live store namespace. This mutates state immediately and should be used after validating the current state snapshot.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

value.description: Value to write to the variable (JSON-compatible serializable object).

renforge_stop.description: Stop the live runtime and cleanup the launch/session state. Running games may be interrupted, and active quick-save/lock state should be considered volatile after stop.

project_path.description: Project root whose active launch should be stopped.

renforge_translation_stats.description: Compute missing/covered translation stats for a language before generation. Run this first, then gate calls to translation generation. This may download and cache the required SDK before analysis.

project_path.description: Project root to analyze.

renforge_wait_until.description: Wait for one stable condition (`label`, `screen`, or `expr`). Prefer `label` or `screen` when possible; `expr` is arbitrary Python evaluated repeatedly in the store namespace and may mutate game state, access the filesystem, start processes, or use the network with the game process's permissions. Keep timeout bounded.

expr.description: Expression condition to evaluate and await success. Evaluated repeatedly during waiting.

include.description: Optional fields to include in compact state output.

label.description: Target label to wait for; provide either label, screen, or expression.

max_depth.description: Maximum object nesting depth in compact state, from 0 through 20.

max_items.description: Maximum list/map items in compact state, from 1 through 10000.

max_output_bytes.description: Payload cap for the result, from 64 through 2000000 bytes.

project_path.description: Project root with active live session.

screen.description: Target screen name to wait for.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time, a finite value between 0 and 120 seconds.

renforge_web_build.description: Run the Ren'Py web build pipeline and write browser assets. It may download/cache the Ren'Py SDK, but requires the separately installed Web DLC and does not download external toolchains or the Web DLC. Destination controls output.

project_path.description: Project root for build output.
